decisive_items: a 3.4×3.3×3.3 cm, well-circumscribed mass in the left cerebellomedullary and premedullary cisterns that was hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images
response.rationale: R1 is more consistent with the imaging characteristics, particularly the well-circumscribed nature and hyperintensity on T1- and T2-weighted images

rejected.why: lack of enhancement is atypical for meningioma
